## Subsystem
- [ ] Hardware CAD / BOM (`hardware/`)
- [ ] Electrical / Wiring (`electrical/`)
- [ ] Firmware (`firmware/`)
- [ ] ROS 2 / Gazebo / MoveIt 2 / GUI (`src/`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs/`)

## Description
A clear description of the bug or unexpected behavior.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Launch command or hardware state
2. Action taken
3. Observed result

## Expected Behavior
What should happen instead.

## Environment
- OS / ROS 2 Distro: (e.g., Ubuntu 24.04 / ROS 2 Jazzy)
- Simulation or Hardware: (`use_sim:=true`, `fast_visual:=true`, mock, or physical arm)
- Commit SHA or branch:
